research_question: Can the compatible native host read the actual oxygen-reduction flowchart with the source-defined BPD categories and primary outcome context?
selection_reason: Uniquely documented retained source-image transport failure; Figure S1 text projection contains only title/legend, not algorithm. No page selected for convenience or label agreement.
operator_inspection: Original appendix physical page 8, printed 7, high-resolution rendering, full Figure S1/legend; main physical page 3, Outcomes; appendix physical page 14, printed13, full Table S4 and notes.

facts.prerequisite: oxygen and/or respiratory support for at least 28 days; otherwise No BPD and no test
facts.eligible: not mechanically ventilated invasively/noninvasively, no CPAP/high-flow therapy; FiO2 <0.3 or low-flow oxygen <1.1 L/min; no respiratory support in preceding24h
facts.branches: after >=28 days: if no longer in oxygen, mild/no test; if still oxygen but lower-oxygen/no-support requirements fail, severe/no test; if requirements pass, oxygen reduction test
facts.image_only_procedure: reduce oxygen gradually to minimum sustaining saturations >=91% for at least10minutes
facts.post_test: air -> mild;22–29% oxygen or0.01–1.0 L/min -> moderate
facts.context: assessment36weeks postmenstrual age; primary composite death or moderate/severe BPD, mild excluded; test distinguishes mild/moderate
facts.legend: FiO2 fraction of inspired oxygen; CPAP continuous positive airway pressure
facts.counts: This diagnostic concerns classification, not participant flow; pages do not establish randomized/followed-up/measured/analyzed/imputed denominators. Do not invent counts.

success_criteria: actual native image delivery and matching provenance
all clinically material flowchart eligibility/routes/procedure/thresholds and primary-outcome relationship correct
explicit citations to FigureS1 physical8 plus main3/TableS4physical14 as relevant
no invented denominators/domainjudgments; uncertainty faithful to source
at least one correct image-exclusive observation (10-minute procedure) that is absent from supplied normal text
failure_policy: Report error for any clinically material incorrect rule; inconclusive for insufficient retrieval/coverage/identity, ambiguous interpretation or no independently attributable image-only fact. No score relaxation, retry or accuracy-gain claim.
